solution_summary: Viable has tackled this challenge by fine-tuning OpenAI’s LLMs to deliver fast and accurate insights from customer support interactions to recorded transcripts and everything in between, using GPT‑4 to analyze qualitative data on a scale that exceeds current techniques and performance. Viable’s platform provides companies with actionable insights to improve their Net Promoter Score (NPS), reduce support ticket volumes, and better inform their product roadmaps, all while saving on operating costs. Viable’s platform makes it effortless for customers to extract insights from their unstructured data in platforms like Zendesk, Intercom, Gong, and more through their seamless integrations, continuous syncing, and automated analysis.
